# Invented memory shapes

All content, handles, round numbers and future date stamps are invented. No
private memory was consulted. These answer audit pass 3 Check 4; continuity
is retired and excluded. Source Markdown uses CRLF.

- memory/lessons.md: Japanese/Cyrillic, numbered points, about 1,900-character
  entry, consecutive duplicate date headings with no intervening body.
- memory/city-rules.md: about 800-character segment, placeholder, explanatory,
  confirmed, proposed and retracted sections matched by city section_status.
- memory/open-threads.md: Living threads, nested bullets, about 5,000-character entry.
- goals.md: H2 only, Japanese/Cyrillic, about 2,200-character segment.
- memory/mission_log/W9000.md: missing final newline; shared recall query.
- memory/mission_log/W10000.md: prose and bullets before the first heading.
- memory/mission_log/W20000.md: consecutive headings without body.
- memory/mission_log/W30000.md: nested bullets.
- memory/mission_log/W40000.md: Japanese/Cyrillic and numbered points.
- memory/mission_log/W50000.md: about 17,000 characters; shared recall query.
- memory/residents/velvetspoon.md: about 4,200 characters and Japanese/Cyrillic.
- memory/residents/paperfinch.md, chalkotter.md, ribbonmole.md, teacupfox.md:
  four additional invented dossiers with distinct handles and IDs.
- memory/residents/index.md: about 7,800 characters. Migration excludes the index;
  explicit reconstruction and line-coverage tests document this as strict xfail.
- identity.md, governance.md: invented whole-file wake inputs.
- naming.json: fixture paths using the live mission_log directory layout.

Brief 18 adds invented heading, dated-entry, duplicate-key, date-named,
extra-section and no-number shapes. crlf-nonascii.md has CRLF, Unicode
and no final newline. All added content is invented.
The local .gitattributes preserves crlf-nonascii.md bytes on every OS.
The unchanged-card snapshot includes exact CRLF and LF checkout variants.
